facts.fact: The UN Economic Commission for Africa reports that the DRC's National Data Governance Strategy (six pillars) was nationally validated at a ceremony in Kinshasa on 13 November 2025 and symbolically handed over to the government, with the workshop still discussing adopting it and integrating amendments.
